Records Retention Standard

This Standard takes effect on 1 January 2026 and supersedes all previous retention schedules.

Article 1 – Scope

1.1 This Standard applies to every record created or received by the Company in the course of its business, in any medium.

1.2 “Record” means information created, received and maintained as evidence of an activity, whether or not it is held in a system of record.

Article 2 – Retention periods

2.1 A record must be retained for the period specified for its Data Class and must then be deleted.

2.2 The retention period for each Data Class is:

  • (a) Employee Record: 6 years from the end of employment;
  • (b) Customer Contract: 7 years from expiry or termination;
  • (c) Financial Record: 7 years from the end of the financial year.

2.3 Where a record falls within more than one Data Class, the longest applicable retention period applies.

Article 3 – Legal hold

3.1 A record subject to a legal hold must not be deleted, and the retention period for that record is suspended for the duration of the hold.

3.2 A legal hold is imposed by the General Counsel in writing and remains in force until lifted in writing.
